I think there is way too much concern expressed about verification of AI output in everyday work due to a risk of factual errors.

It used to be true, but data on more recent models suggest they beat human experts, including PhD specialists, in finding facts and checking claims. https://t.co/OVlzW3S17n
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我觉得大家对日常工作中核实 AI 输出、担心事实错误这件事过度焦虑了。
